title: Reduced collage, Nano Banana
prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop landing-page DESIGN CONCEPT for a Russian psychology conference. Edge-to-edge website mockup, 4:3 landscape. Show first screen and the beginning of the next section. Bold contemporary cultural-festival art direction, inspired by the daring scale of Young Con and precision of Osmo, with a REDUCED EDITORIAL COLLAGE. The previous direction was rejected because of visual clutter. The solution is radical simplicity with surprising cropping. Only TWO photographic fragments, ONE small conversational line, and a clear typography hierarchy. No decorative filler.

Composition: a warm off-white canvas occupies most of the page. Minimal navigation at top: АСП on left, Программа and Спикеры on right. A very large, sophisticated medium-weight Cyrillic grotesk headline dominates the upper half with confident uneven line lengths. Exact headline, all words readable, normal sentence case: "Как превратить знания из вуза в первую практику". Nothing overlays the text. Use dark ink-violet typography. Small line above: "Студенческая конференция 2.0". Under headline place small date "21 ноября 2026 · онлайн" and solid purple rectangular button with modest corner radius, text "Зарегистрироваться бесплатно". Smaller text near button: "Карта психологических подходов — после регистрации".

Below and to the far right, compose an unexpected tightly integrated asymmetrical photographic collage: ONE oversized cutout of a young adult woman's head and shoulder in a natural engaged conversational expression, framed unusually and partly cropped by the right viewport edge. ONE much smaller monochrome documentary photo showing two adults mid-conversation, offset left of and partially overlapping the lower shoulder, cropped into a simple sharp rectangle. The two photographs should form ONE cohesive visual cluster, not scattered fragments. The figure overlaps into the next section, breaking the section boundary. Place the single conversational line "А дальше — практика" in small regular grotesk near this photo junction. No extra text fragments. Photography has realistic skin, candid character, soft directional light, not glossy stock coaching imagery. No school props.

Lower 20% of canvas introduces the next scene in pale lilac with headline "С чего начнётся ваша практика?" at left and only three simple text links at right: "С чего начать", "Выбор метода", "Путь с нуля". These are actual programme tracks, not cards. A fine rule can organize them. Create rhythmic tension with extreme image scale, negative space and one overlap. Keep about half of the composition empty/light. High-end magazine composition and event identity, clean flat colour.

Palette only warm offwhite, deep ink violet, one saturated violet accent, pale lilac. No graph-paper background, no grid, no torn-paper effects, no eye-strip, no microphone, no cables or lines connecting things, no handwritten lettering, no doodles, no stickers, no pills, no gift icons, no quotation-mark icons, no stars, no arrows as decoration, no circles or blobs, no gradient, no shadows on UI, no all-caps except АСП. No fake Academy name expansion, no invented speakers/reviews/logos/statistics. This must feel like a bold website with intentional composition, not a furniture ad, scrapbook, academic template or symmetric SaaS hero. Exact Russian spelling.
